boundaries.description: Functional core: pure domain logic, ports and parsers; imports itself and pure libraries only, never infra/orchestration
Adapters: Redis/BullMQ, Telegram, filesystem, subprocesses, HTTP; implement core ports, never call orchestration
Shell orchestrators: wire core decisions to infra adapters (reclaw convention, workspace architecture.md: orchestration may import infra adapters directly); never the composition root
Composition root: builds adapters and hands them to orchestrators

plans.reason: a plan cites its spec's ids and ADRs; it names files not built yet, so only those are resolved
